skill.title: Rate
skill.promise: You can find distance per step.

lessons.title: Per step

screens.prompt: A trip covers 6 in 2 equal steps. Each step covers...

feedback.wrong_option: 6 is the whole trip. 2 is the number of steps. Divide.

screens.prompt: 12 units in 3 equal steps. Set the rate per step.

feedback.too_low: 12 split into 3 is higher. Move up.
feedback.too_high: 12 split into 3 is lower. Move down.

screens.correctMessage: The rate is distance divided by steps.

screens.prompt: 8 units in 2 equal steps. Set the rate.

feedback.too_low: 8 split into 2 is higher. Move up.
feedback.too_high: 8 split into 2 is lower. Move down.

screens.correctMessage: Each step covers the same ground.

feedback.wrong_option: Adding the step count to the distance is not a rate.

screens.prompt: Each step runs 2 right. Draw two steps from (1, 3).

feedback.wrong_direction: The steps stay on the horizontal line.
feedback.wrong_length: Two steps of 2 land 4 to the right.

screens.correctMessage: The rate is 2, and two steps use it twice.

lessons.whyItMatters: Learning rate is how far a step moves for each unit of slope.

lessons.title: Fewer steps

screens.prompt: A covers 8 in 4 steps. B covers 8 in 2 steps. Which is faster?

options.label: A, because it takes more steps

feedback.wrong_option: More steps for the same distance is the slower rate.

screens.correctMessage: Fewer steps, same distance, faster rate.

screens.prompt: Same distance 10, in 2 steps. Set the rate.

feedback.too_low: 10 split into 2 is higher. Move up.
feedback.too_high: 10 split into 2 is lower. Move down.

screens.correctMessage: This trip is the fast one.

screens.prompt: Same distance 12, in 4 steps. Set the rate.

feedback.too_low: 12 split into 4 is higher. Move up.
feedback.too_high: 12 split into 4 is lower. Move down.

screens.correctMessage: More steps make a slower rate.

options.label: More steps for the same distance

feedback.wrong_option: More steps for the same distance slows the rate.

screens.correctMessage: Faster is more ground per step.

screens.prompt: A short steep step and a long shallow trip cover the same ground. The steep step has...

options.label: The lower rate, because the trip is shorter

feedback.wrong_option: A shorter trip with the same ground is the higher rate.

screens.correctMessage: Steep here means the higher rate.

lessons.whyItMatters: The same drop in fewer steps is a faster rate.
